SeedsPlease.SeedDef.label: ice crystal flower seeds
SeedsPlease.SeedDef.description: Genetically engineered seeds extracted from blizzard shattered crystals. Once sown in a hydroponic basin, they will grow into ice crystal flowers in an enclosed room.

SeedsPlease.SeedDef.label: snowy crystal tree seeds
SeedsPlease.SeedDef.description: Genetically engineered seeds extracted from blizzard shattered crystals. Once sown in a hydroponic basin, they will grow into a snowy crystal tree.

ThingDef.label: windstorm tree species
ThingDef.description: The basic tree species used for planting snow crystal trees, whether for cooling in summer or simply for outdoor decoration, snow crystal trees are an excellent choice.\n\nIn some tribes or beliefs, this tree is considered a symbol of the god of wind and snow. It is said that when these trees merge into forests and leaves into clouds, it means that this planet will face eternal ice.
